keyFindings.description: refuseCodePipeInTableCell goes through replacementBroke, which exempts the whole document-level block when TableCodePipeError already fails on it before the write. API edits run on the live tree, which keeps a browser-left code `a\|b` after settlement, so a later replace, delete or accepted suggestion that puts code holding `\|` into another cell of that table (or another table in the same list or quote) is accepted and stored with that `|` taken out of the code. Reproduced at 30d6bc60 with a throwaway applyAlone test: stored `| `a\`\|`b` | `<code>\`\|`<code>` |`, no refusal. The PR body and CHANGELOG (packages/envoy/CHANGELOG.md:1340) say such writes are refused. Fix: refuse when the block after the write holds an offending code span the block before did not (compare per cell, e.g. (row, column, code) of every offending cell), keeping the exemption only for writes that add none.

No `## Contract change census`. The PR adds a refusal at the Dispatch HTTP API (TableCodePipeError on doc-edit replace, delete by quote and accepted suggestion) and widens one (a row whose cells exceed the table once `\\|` ends a cell, on upload and table-row insert; insert_test.go:140), and a header wider than its delimiter by the new rule now makes no table. The census must list the search commands (in-repo writers of a mid-row `\\|` and the stored-document census), each hit with its disposition (the 8 rewritten documents among them), and the rollout line (immediate refusal, naming the data loss or misread it closes).

altReadsBack's comment says Parse reads a `|` after an even run of backslashes in a cell as escaped, now false; the pipeAfterEvenBackslashes guard is dead (both thermonuclear agents removed it in a scratch copy and saw no behaviour change). Delete the sentence and guard; move pipeAfterEvenBackslashes into table_test.go, its only other user.

tableCodePipe.Error lays the table out on a fresh span budget, while GET /blocks uses spansBefore(doc, table); the doc comment says the cell is named as GET /blocks places it. They differ only once earlier tables spend maxSpanCells.

The browser-edit path stores the `|` as text after the code rather than refusing, against the spec decision's wording 'refused on write'. Accepted: a CRDT edit has no refusal channel and every character is kept; the documents and PR body name it. Recorded in Not proven / risk for the architect.
